_doc: Journey地図の地域(ステージ)定義。build-map-data.mjs が読む。新地域はここに1エントリ追加＋geojson供給で対応（コード変更不要）。順序=出力stagesの順序。
attribution: 地図データ: 国土地理院（地球地図日本）／Natural Earth

world.mapshaper: npx -y mapshaper ne110/ne_110m_land.shp -simplify weighted 40% keep-shapes -o format=geojson precision=0.1 out/world.json

japan.mapshaper: npx -y mapshaper polbnda_jpn.shp -dissolve2 -clip bbox=127,29.5,147,46.5 -simplify weighted 5% keep-shapes -filter-islands min-area=4km2 -o format=geojson precision=0.005 out/japan.json

ryukyu.mapshaper: npx -y mapshaper polbnda_jpn.shp -dissolve2 -clip bbox=122,23,132.5,30 -simplify weighted 22% keep-shapes -filter-islands min-area=1km2 -o format=geojson precision=0.002 out/ryukyu.json

miyako.mapshaper: npx -y mapshaper polbnda_jpn.shp -dissolve2 -clip bbox=124.55,24.55,125.75,25.15 -simplify weighted 85% keep-shapes -o format=geojson precision=0.0005 out/miyako.json
